acceptanceCriteria: Capability-show CLI defaults come from the protocol-owned description facts rather than duplicated literals.
CLI parsing, MCP schema projection, and capability description remain consistent for defaults, enums, and types.
The discovery path is deterministic, read-only, and does not start verification or inspect Work Item history.
goal: Changing one capability-show default in cockpit-protocol must update CLI behavior and discovered descriptions without separately editing CLI and MCP facts.
intent: Complete the BAML-style interface discovery trial by removing remaining duplicated capability-show defaults from the CLI adapter and keeping the protocol description as the single source of interface facts.
